answer: The umber counter is kept in grove and marble reveals each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 251 aliases cost 104 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
